decision: Adopt localized observation repair before isolated-voice boundary stage, or retain reference and choose another bounded observation approach after review. No automatic follow-on.
primary: Exact PR8 config/model with old observations vs exact same config/model with new observations. No primary parameter fitting.
adapter: Earliest local NSDF periodicity peak above threshold, parabolic lag interpolation; range80..2000Hz selected before development, RMS>=.01. Report original spectral peak, all periodic candidates and uncertainty. Avoid unconditional divide-by-two. Finite threshold grid .85/.9/.95 selected on development only by group pitch accuracy then error then lowest threshold.
calibration: 8 fresh groups processed with frozen development-selected adapter and unchanged probability config; no fitting or parameter selection on calibration. Calibration used for pre-evaluation integrity checks.
baselines: For each adapter separately: marginal, recency, transition orders1,2,3, full order3 absolute retrieval, full order3 relative retrieval (primary); same arrived blocks and capacity. Reference probability settings for corresponding algorithm kept fixed. No intentionally reduced history.
factors: split_manifest.json documents fractional factorial and unavoidable aliases. Every split crosses direction/register/dominance independently; order balanced but aliases their three-factor interaction. Pure/fundamental subtype aliases direction-register interaction within non-rich half. Level changes by group block, never binding label.
renderers: stimuli.py formulas; all unique parameter tuples/seeds; heldout durations beyond calibration. Fundamental nonzero; overtone-rich amplitudes .25+.001*i,1,.22+.001*i; pure sine and fundamental-dominant subfamilies. New normalized Q=(0,-a,b),R=(0,-c,b), b>0 unlike earlier studies.
controls: same joint reset/removal/swap/chunk-shuffle/ambiguous semantics as PR9; byte-multiset paired histories and common current cue; unknown metadata never supplied to worker.
score_coordinates: scoring.py maps 50 relative-bin probabilities to common absolute A220-semitone integer bins -48..72, plus unknown prediction. Unknown is never a correct known-pitch outcome. Out-of-range known truth has zero forecast mass and +Infinity logloss; no clipping. Quantization by nearest absolute semitone. Point tolerance .35 using continuous pitch. Brier expected realized categorical error. Positive infinity serialized string +Infinity. Tests include zero-probability, unavailable, out-of-range, ambiguous, octave mapping.

bootstrap.unit: equally weighted heldout phrase groups paired across comparisons
bootstrap.method: Bonferroni percentile bootstrap three contrasts; no post-hoc cell selection
bootstrap.quantile_method: inverted_cdf order statistic avoids interpolation of infinite log-loss bounds; observations use within-subfamily group resampling with same seed

octave_safety: Predefined pure/fundamental groups only; count every pitched arrived prefix block across all 18 streams, not future blocks. Per-group correct fraction averaged equally >=.95, octave-error group rate <=.01. Octave error means available estimate within .35 semitones of truth±12; unavailable counted incorrect, availability reported separately. Also report ±24 errors separately. Prediction loss averaged equally over these groups and four intact cells <=.05 versus old primary. Report pure/fundamental separately, same thresholds on combined predeclared guard.
adoption: All assignment A conditions conjunctive, implemented analyze.py. Otherwise B if valid explicit failed criterion; invalid if validity fails; no forced adoption.
resources_accounting: Stream reservation ledger, split runtimes, conservative single-worker wall-clock work interval <=2h; no parallel acoustic work.
oracle: None planned; earlier oracle evidence remains historical. Only saved estimator/availability evidence used to explain observed failure.
stop: Publish one complete successor with PROJECT_STATE update then await review; no repair retest.
metric_limits: Mean absolute fundamental error conditional on availability, alongside unconditional pitch accuracy and availability. Unavailable blocks cannot meet octave-safety accuracy. Known out-of-range targets score infinite loss, not unknown success.
